subject: Capacity structure proposal & GPU-price protection ask
messages:
From: Eleanor Park <ep@neurolabs.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@neurolabs.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Reserved capacity ask for POC -> pricing guardrails

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers look promising. Our procurement team asked me to follow up with a concrete ask: we expect to run an internal POC in July with sustained peak inference of ~75 concurrent streams (12M tokens/day) and then go to pilot in Q4. We are interested in a reserved capacity commitment but need protection for GPU price volatility and clarity on discount bands for committed tiers.

Specifically, could Redwood propose:
- a phased commitment (POC->Pilot->Scale) with clear SKU mapping (e.g., 8xA100 equiv slots -> 32xA100 equiv)
- a price floor or indexation clause if cloud GPU costs increase >15% vs signing time
- a list of what approvals are needed for discounts >15% and typical lead times

Attached is our RFP extract (NeuroLabs_RFP_Q3.xlsx). Happy to schedule a call if that helps.

Best,
Eleanor Park
Head of Platform Engineering
NeuroLabs

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Eleanor Park <ep@neurolabs.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reserved capacity ask for POC -> pricing guardrails

Eleanor — thanks for the clear outline and the RFP excerpt. We're aligned on a phased commit approach; a couple notes from our side:

1) Sizing options
- Phase 1 (POC, 8 weeks): 8 slots (A100-equivalent), soft cap with burst credits
- Phase 2 (Pilot, 3 months): 24 slots, guaranteed throughput
- Phase 3 (Scale): 32–48 slots depending on usage triggers and model variant

2) Price protection options we can offer (high-level)
- Fixed discount floor (e.g., min 10% off list for first 12 months)
- Indexation clause: tie per-token price to a GPU market index with a +/- band; if index moves >12% we re-open pricing review
- Protective cap: customer may elect a price-protection credit if cloud GPU spot index rises above threshold during committed term

3) Approvals & lead times
- Discounts up to 12%: handled by pricing team (Kimberly) within 3 business days
- Discounts 12–20%: requires sales director sign-off (Marissa) + finance review ~5 business days
- >20%: executive approval and legal covenanting, ~10 business days

Can Kimberly add recommended bands and where we should draw the escalation line? If that looks ok to NeuroLabs, Marissa and I can move to a draft term sheet + DocuSign.

On scheduling, I can do a 30-min call tomorrow afternoon to walk through the triggers.

— Logan
Logan Wright
Head of Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Eleanor Park <ep@neurolabs.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reserved capacity ask for POC -> pricing guardrails

Team / Eleanor — adding pricing guardrails we typically recommend for deals sized like this:

Recommended discount bands (per committed $ spend):
- $0–$150k / mo: standard list pricing (no additional discount)
- $150k–$350k / mo: 8–12% off list (pricing team approval)
- $350k–$750k / mo: 12–18% off list (sales director approval)
- >$750k / mo: 18–25% off list (requires exec finance sign-off and conditional SLAs)

Guard clauses for GPU-price volatility:
- 12% index band: price locked unless GPU market index moves > +/-12%; if breach occurs we offer a review and either (a) temporary surcharge capped at +8% for up to 90 days or (b) a one-time customer credit equivalent to the surcharge if they elected a fixed-floor option.
- Phased commit credit: if customer scales from Phase 1->2 within 90 days, we apply a pro-rated conversion credit of up to 6% on the Phase 2 AR.

Approval path & RACI
- Kim: pricing config and tiering
- Marissa: discount exceptions >12%
- Finance: final approval for escalator constructs and if any non-standard credit exposure is needed (Karthik looped for impact on reserved fleet allocation).

Attached is a short workbook with proposed bands and modeled examples (Redwood_Pricing_Tiers_v1.xlsx).

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Principal Pricing Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Eleanor Park <ep@neurolabs.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@neurolabs.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reserved capacity ask for POC -> pricing guardrails

Thanks — that framework is very helpful. A few clarifying points from procurement:

- NeuroLabs prefers a fixed-floor option for the first 12 months (min 10% off list) plus the indexation clause thereafter.
- We need explicit trigger language for the indexation clause (what index, lookback, notification window). Can Redwood propose the index and exact trigger wording?
- Approval timing: we need any discount exception confirmed before our procurement review on 6/2 to meet our board timing.

Attached is our RFP excerpt and the draft SLA addendum with our security checklist (Draft_SLA_Addendum.pdf). If you can provide the explicit index wording and confirm who signs off on any >12% exceptions by Monday EOD 6/1, we can proceed to term-sheet.

Regards,
Eleanor

Eleanor / team — we can move forward with the fixed-floor + indexation construct. Quick operational commitments from Redwood:

- Executive exception approved: up to 20% discount floor for first 12 months subject to signed 12-month commitment and standard credit checks.
- Index: we'll use the publicly available GPU Spot Index (Redwood-GPU-Spot Index); lookback 30 days, notification window 14 days, breach threshold 12%.
- If NeuroLabs confirms by 6/1 EOD we will: (a) lock initial pricing and (b) issue a draft term-sheet + DocuSign by 6/4.

Karthik — please reserve additional capacity in our dedicated pool pending legal term sign-off; mark it tentative in the allocation sheet and flag any HPC scheduling conflicts. Kimberly, please prepare the final pricing lines for DocuSign.

Eleanor — appreciate the quick turnaround. Logan / I will also run the SLAs by legal for the addendum.

—Marissa Cole
